title: Mobile/touch: tapping selects/highlights the whole app, obscuring controls
description:
## Repro (mobile/touch device)
On a touch device, tap or long-press anywhere on the editor chrome (toolbar, panels, timeline, stage area). The browser highlights / selects the underlying UI text and elements (and on iOS pops the callout menu), drawing a selection rectangle/highlight that obscures controls.

## Root cause (file:line)
No global user-select / touch-callout / tap-highlight suppression on the app chrome.
- apps/desktop/src/styles.css:1-31 — the ONLY global stylesheet. It sets box-sizing/margins, html/body/#root sizing, and body font, but NO 'user-select: none', '-webkit-touch-callout: none', or '-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent'. So default text/element selection is active app-wide.
- packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx:370-379 (styles.shell, applied to the root div at Shell.tsx:2942-2944) — the app root container also sets no userSelect. Individual panels/dialogs set userSelect:"none" piecemeal (e.g. MenuBar.tsx:52, StatusBar.tsx:28, LibraryPanel.tsx, PropertiesPanel.tsx, many dialogs), but there is no single rule covering the whole app chrome, so gaps between/around those panels (and the stage work area) remain selectable.

On desktop a stray click rarely produces a visible selection, so this was latent; touch long-press/tap reliably triggers native selection, exposing the gap.

## Expected vs actual
- Expected: tapping/long-pressing UI chrome does nothing visible; selection is allowed ONLY inside genuine text inputs and the code/Actions editor.
- Actual: taps highlight/select arbitrary UI text and elements, obscuring controls.

## Fix direction
- Add to the app chrome (cleanest: apps/desktop/src/styles.css on body/.app-shell, or styles.shell in Shell.tsx:370):
  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
- Re-enable selection where it is legitimately wanted: input/textarea/[contenteditable] and the Actions/code editor (user-select: text). The inline text-edit textarea overlay in StageArea and form inputs in dialogs must stay selectable.

## Classification
Mobile/touch is an UNSUPPORTED-PLATFORM GAP, not a regression (desktop-only Tauri editor; no touch/responsive code exists; no docs claim mobile). Priority medium.

## References
- apps/desktop/src/styles.css:1-31 (global CSS, no user-select)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx:370-379 (styles.shell root), 2942-2944 (root div)
- Sibling tasks: touch stage-drawing, responsive right-pane.
